decision.headline: Expedition cleared with strong defense
decision.summary: Autopilot demonstration: all 6 stages and 6 contracts were completed on Story difficulty, with 74 reflected bullets and 16/16 hull remaining.
decision.strength: The run combined 74 reflected bullets with only 2 hull points lost, while defeating 6 bosses and 242 enemies for a score of 104920.
decision.improvement: For future practice, try moving and dashing more deliberately while conserving Nova for dangerous encounters, even with 16/16 hull remaining.
decision.nextRun: Consider another 6-stage Expedition run and aim to preserve the strong defense while building consistency beyond 33 grazes.
